name: tandoor
title: Tandoor
description: A curry-house theme whose ground is flock wallpaper — one crimson damask repeat on maroon, in both schemes — with the restaurant’s name set straight on it in brass Didone capitals, and the navigation, every page and each section of the menu laid over it on square-cut white linen.

tokens.--font-display: the site title, navigation, headings, dish names, prices, hours labels and the button — high-contrast Didone letters, mostly in capitals
tokens.--font-body: body text, dish descriptions and summaries — a sturdy transitional serif
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--text-title: size of the site title on the wallpaper, growing with the screen
tokens.--tracking-title: letter spacing of the site title and of the menu’s section names on the wall
tokens.--tracking-caps: wider letter spacing of the small capital labels: navigation, dates, hours labels, the button, second-level headings, the footer name, pagination
tokens.--color-bg: the linen: the background of every panel that carries text — navigation strip, pages, each table of the menu, footer (white by day, dim ivory at night). The wall behind it is --color-wall and --color-flock
tokens.--color-text: body text, page titles, navigation links, prices, the heavy rules of the hours card and of table heads, and the inner focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dish descriptions, standfirsts, quotations, the footer line, and the small name of a section outside the standard ten
tokens.--color-accent: links, dish names, hours labels, dates and the labels above a title, second-level headings, list markers, the current navigation link and its bar, the lozenge rule under page titles, and the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines on the linen: between hours rows, between posts, in tables, the horizontal rule, above pagination
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks
tokens.--color-wall: the page ground: the maroon the wallpaper is flocked on, and the soft halo round the brass lettering
tokens.--color-flock: the damask motif repeated across the whole wall
tokens.--color-relief: the dark edge under each motif that makes the flock stand up, and the hard shadow under the brass lettering
tokens.--color-brass: the site title and the menu’s section names — the only lettering on the wall — and the outer band of the focus ring
tokens.--shadow-panel: the shadow the linen casts on the wall: one offset, blur and colour
tokens.--measure: width of the linen panels: pages, the menu and the footer
tokens.--tile: width of one repeat of the damask (three quarters of it on a phone)
tokens.--gutter: space between the linen and the edge of the screen
tokens.--pad: padding inside the linen panels, and at the sides of each menu row
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules: top and bottom of the hours card, under table heads, beside a quotation, and (a pixel more) the bar under the current navigation link
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the linen panels and the button — zero: linen is cut square
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under a summary, above the button in the hours card
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under a date or label, under headings in page text, table cell padding
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and between posts, the strip of cloth above and below each menu section, footer padding
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks: under the page title, above headings, round the hours card, the strip of wall above each menu section name
tokens.--space-5: the wall left above the footer and below it
